activities.activity: Sleeping through the night, fan on for air circulation
Waking up, showering and getting ready for the day
Eating breakfast and making a thermos of tea for the day
Reviewing clinical placement notes and packing nursing uniform, ID badge and study bag
Commuting by public transport to the hospital clinical placement site
Nursing clinical placement: patient observations, medication rounds under supervision and documenting care
Taking a lunch break at the placement site
Continuing clinical placement duties, assisting with personal care and handover preparation
Commuting home by public transport after placement
Showering and changing out of uniform after the clinical shift
Preparing a simple dinner using the induction cooker and microwave
Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen bench
Loading and running a load of laundry in the washing machine
Studying Bachelor of Nursing coursework on the computer and writing up placement reflections under the desk lamp
Making a light snack and herbal tea while reviewing pharmacy assistant shift notes
Winding down, checking phone messages and setting an alarm
